updates.text: Implemented a dark themed UI with history charts, live compute news feed, and one‑tap demo trade on the Silica web app.
Started near-hackathon-2026: a web app that tracks compute prices, publishes a Silica Compute Index to NEAR, and offers hourly futures on the index.
Added skill project‑agnostic architecture, deterministic model config, and a Windows installer for the orchestrator.
Started claude-parallel-agents: a PowerShell orchestrator that decomposes tasks, launches cheap Claude or OpenCode agents in detached processes to write files, then reviews diffs and commits.
Started ascend90: a static web app that tracks a 90‑day transformation plan across six pillars, using Groq AI to coach and roast the user, storing data in localStorage.
Added offline service worker, web app manifest, icons, and integrated Groq AI coach with prayer‑time fetch, game rules, and localStorage persistence.

Started afterburner: a 3D fighter jet simulator using Panda3D, featuring a physically based rendering pipeline, a high‑detail Su‑57 model, and an edge‑of‑space world with realistic lighting and atmosphere.
